title_en: Artificial Intelligence (10/20): The Smart Speaker at Home
note_en: Doubling a verb softens it into a quick, casual try: 查一查明天的天气预报 "check tomorrow's forecast," 试一试 "give it a try," 看一看 "take a look," 聊聊家常 "chat about everyday things." With 一 in the middle (查一查) or without (看看), the doubled verb sounds relaxed and polite, where English would add "quickly," "a bit," or "have a go." With a past action 了 goes in the middle: 试着喊了一喊 "tried giving a shout."
